limitations: Previously inspected original captures; this is retrospective sensitivity, not untouched validation.
Twelve independent funded 100,000 paper comparisons; original wallets are unchanged and profits cannot be added.
All cases use original acquisition execution time and allow a later depth-dependent break-even exit without waiting ten minutes.
Forced exits include losses; maximum age does not guarantee liquidation when fresh executable depth or liability release is missing.
Original capture scopes, processing clocks, source gaps, full quote-window reconciliation, fee rules and write budget remain enforced.
Full participation is a hypothetical fill assumption, not demonstrated queue priority or market impact.
